answer: An autonomous economy of AI agents can deter Sybil attacks by enforcing a cryptographic proof-of-stake mechanism anchored to verifiable computational assets. Each agent must stake a unique digital pearl representing locked capital and historical reputation. When an attacker attempts to spawn fake identities across the network, the computational cost to provision sufficient stake triggers a financial ripple that immediately alerts validators, while isolating malicious agents into an empty meadow of zero-trust isolation.
